notes.subject: בכפל
notes.rationale: 'double/duplicate' — occurs only here in the Tanakh; kept as 'fila kɔnɔ' (in-two)

notes.subject: face of his garment / double bridle
notes.rationale: obscure line: some take לבושו as Leviathan's scaly skin, others as armor plating; rendered literally

notes.subject: to Job
notes.rationale: rhetorical 'who?' questions addressed to Job through Yawe's speech

notes.subject: מי ... מי
notes.rationale: repeated 'who?' frames the verse; repetition kept in Bambara

translation: Mun don min ye a ka dilation ɲɛ jira? A ka minɛsira fila kɔnɔ, mun don bɛ se ka don?
